description: Repository hosting Claude Code skills for RS School mentors plus reference curriculum and student configs. Each entry below is a skill (or other shipped artifact) in this repo, not a sub-feature inside a skill — per-skill internal scope is tracked in commit messages.

features.name: Pocket Mentor — student PR review
features.description: Claude Code skill that runs inside a cloned student repository: bash checkers (init.sh, check-ts-usage, check-no-console, check-git-quality, check-commented-code) + LLM analysis grounded in clean-code/*, optionally guided by a task rubric loaded via --context. Output: CODE_REVIEW_REPORT.md (local), inline PR comments (--output inline), or GitHub issues (--output issues). Stack detection: HTML/CSS, Vanilla JS, TypeScript, React+TS. Angular guard.
features.evidence: Three live smoke runs on student fun-chat PR (2026-05-19/20). Commits v0.9.1..v0.9.6 ship iterative fixes (bash-3.2 compat, .env.example false-positive, --context failure-mode, self-check on Fix snippets, score-vs-penalty rules, colored stderr output).
features.next: Watch: rubric-violation-as-Critical severity escalation. v1.0.2 fun-chat test had magic numbers → 🔴 (may be correct per 'blocks pass' definition since RS School rubric blocks acceptance, or an over-correction from the pad-findings rule). Defer v1.0.3 fix until a 2nd observation on a project where the rubric violation is the only failing class (no build/lint/security blockers). If pattern confirms — add to Severity levels: 'Quantifiable rubric violation alone ≠ Critical; severity depends on impact (build/security/correctness → 🔴; quality/style → 🟡).'
